name: scrypt
description: SCRYPT is a simple shellcode encryptor/encoder that uses the OpenSSL library to encrypt a shellcode using the AES-256-CBC encryption algorithm then applies several encoding techniques to obfuscate a given shellcode file. This encrypted/encoded shellcode can be used for both legitimate and malicious purposes, such as exploiting system vulnerability

name: WindowsProcInj
description: A lightweight C program to inject shellcode into a specified Windows process. It utilizes the Windows API to identify the target process, allocate memory, write the shellcode, and create a new thread for execution. Designed for educational and research purposes.
